create_blip2_vision_config: create a Blip2VisionConfig instance with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and patch_size for the vision encoder
create_blip2_qformer_config: create a Blip2QFormerConfig instance with custom cross_attention_frequency and encoder_hidden_size for the Q-Former transformer
create_blip2_config: create a Blip2Config instance combining vision, qformer, and text configs for the full BLIP-2 multimodal model
init_blip2_config_defaults: initialize a Blip2Config with None sub-configs to auto-populate defaults for vision, qformer, and OPT text configs
build_blip2_config_from_dicts: build a Blip2Config by passing dict-style configuration for vision, qformer, and text sub-configs
